name: Chaos Devie
description: Erratique brouillant les senseurs adverses par des mouvements aléatoires détournant les attaques loin des alliés de l'Incursion.

subject.archetype: Chaos Devie — Incursion Dissonante Common class radiation

loadout.armor_outfit: Fragmented armor with each plate phasing at different dimensions and times out of sync with reality, impossible geometries connecting segments creating shapes mind cannot process, unnatural spectrum colors shifting and glitching randomly, portions flickering between solid and translucent ghostly state in rapid succession
loadout.arsenal: Reality-fracturing blade cutting through dimensional barriers leaving visible spatial tears trailing where physics breaks down, paradox generator causing multiple versions of weapon to phase in and out simultaneously from different angles, glitch emitter integrated into off-hand disrupting enemy targeting at quantum level creating visual distortion fields Functional combat equipment showing signs of heavy practical use and field customization

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Combat stance with weapon or tool raised and ready, eyes locked on approaching threat, body coiled like a spring ready to explode into action
attitude.emotion: Focused determination — seasoned professional locked in the moment of combat

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Magenta Glitch
palette_names.role: primary_accent — reality fracture edges and distortion boundaries

palette_names.name: Fractured Green
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — dimensional tear cores and anomaly centers

palette_names.name: Chromatic Aberration Rainbow
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — visual artifacts where colors separate and bleed

color_and_light.lighting_setup: brushed steel utility frame, simple geometric corner markers, no ornamentation, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Eye-level medium shot capturing face and primary action clearly, shallow depth of field, motion freeze at peak of action

scenography.setting: Reality collapse zone with environment fragmenting into multiple parallel versions simultaneously, buildings existing in two dimensions at once showing both intact and destroyed overlapping states, sky displaying conflicting celestial bodies that should not coexist, gravity malfunctioning causing debris to fall upward and sideways in different zones, ground cracking open revealing parallel battlefields layered on each other like corrupt image
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Tension and lethal potential visible in every tensed muscle — combat readiness radiating from posture and grip on weapon, Active combat zone with explosions and engagements around the character, allies and enemies locked in fierce battle, chaos of war as backdrop, Reality shattering like cracked glass across scene with fragments revealing parallel dimensions, chromatic aberration tearing colors apart at high speed creating RGB separation, objects phasing in and out mid-explosion with parts appearing and disappearing, gravity distorting sending debris every direction simultaneously, temporal stutter showing same motion frozen in multiple positions at once creating ghost trails
